items.title: CR-13: Collapse resolved conversations, and let a reviewer hide every comment on a page.
items.body:
Resolved agent threads crowd every document the requester reads, and a reviewer can't read a document without its comments. This change collapses resolved threads and adds one control that hides every comment.

What is expected:
- Each resolved conversation shows as a summary row until the reviewer opens it.
- One control hides and shows every comment, and the verdict never happens with comments hidden.

Out of scope:
- The menu and home page, which CR-9 delivered, and GitHub's own pages.

Definition of done:
- Every acceptance criterion in the PRD passes in a browser test.
- The page checks pass with collapsed rows and with comments hidden.
- Its PRD, HLD and LLD are folded into the project documents.

items.title: T-1: Collapse resolved conversations, and add the hide control and its page mode.
items.body:
The change touches only the review page, and its parts depend on each other. So it lands as one task, and it covers six requirements because each is a small part of the same page change.

What is expected:
- A resolved conversation renders as a `details` element with a summary row, as the LLD describes.   An opened one stays open while the page is open.
- A later reply on a local thread shows it in full. A GitHub thread follows GitHub's state.
- The hide control sets `state.commentsHidden`, and every render applies the page mode from it.   Elements marked `hide` disappear, and elements marked `plain` keep their words without styling.   Focus stays on the control.
- Opening the comment box or the finish panel clears `state.commentsHidden`, so comments show at   verdict time.

Scope:
- In: `web/app.js`, `web/review.js`, `web/select.js`, `web/inline.js`, `web/app.css`,   `test/ui.test.ts`, `test/pages.test.ts`, and this tracker.
- Out: anything on the server or in the stored files.

How to check:
- Browser tests cover each PRD acceptance criterion, at 400 pixels for the summary rows.
- A browser test turns the mode on and checks that no comment text stays visible.
- The page checks in `test/pages.test.ts` run with collapsed rows and with comments hidden.
- Two points come from the LLD reviews for code review. The `toggle` event doesn't bubble, so its   listener needs the capture phase. The FR-3 test needs a reply that is strictly later than the   resolution.

Definition of done:
- The change is merged in one pull request within the size budget.
- Every check above passes, and each new test fails on the base first.
- Every finding from the fresh review is fixed, each with a regression test.
- The row's PR, actual size, dates and notes are filled in.
